Name: Hellfall
Author: Kr1mbus
Description:
[size=6]Summary[/size]

[size=4]After completing the community center, Abigail sends you a letter to investigate a crack in the mines. On further inspection, you fall through the cracks and find yourself in a building for the company of Hellfall, the management for the afterlife. 
As you explore the building, a conspiracy is revealed which ousted Luci, the previous boss of Hellfall. You meet with a few of the seven deadly sins as you try to put Luci back in power. This Stardew Valley mod is lighthearted, whimsical, and has a reward of new crops.

[/size][size=6]Features[/size]
[size=5]Hellfall location
[/size][size=4]Hellfall is a custom world the player can travel to through the mines. There are 5 floors the player can travel to. each floor is defined by the deadly sin that lives on it. on the 4th floor there is a ring that contains 5 enemies daily that drop souls and some exp. 

[/size][size=5]Devil's Lettuce
[/size][size=4]Devil's Lettuce is a new crop that you can grow with this mod. You get the seeds by completing all the quests for the mod. the seed takes 14 days to grow, but it will regrow in 6 days when the Devil's Lettuce is picked from the crop. The Devil's Lettuce item is consumable and sells for 100 gold. It also give the player buffs such as speed and defense.
[/size][size=6]

This mod was created as a team project for a game modding class within The School of Interactive Games and Media (IGM)at Rochester Institute of Technology in Rochester NY. IGM provides an educational environment that supports and encourages creative and collaborative academic inquiry by both faculty and students. IGM’s programs,  coursework, research, and development efforts provide students with the knowledge and skills to pursue meaningful  and rewarding careers in media-centric, interactive software development, while simultaneously advancing the field and helping to provide a well-rounded educational experience.
